brief:
Israeli colonizers carried out multiple attacks across the Ramallah area Monday, invading a village, attempting to steal livestock, and attacking Palestinian vehicles, according to IMEMC News. The settlers also expanded an illegal colonial outpost east of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank.

The incidents marked a continuation of settler violence in the region, which has seen repeated incursions and property seizures targeting Palestinian communities.
